title: Lightly Smoky Japanese Purple Sprouting Broccoli Dorayaki
description: A malty, molten, brunch-mood Japanese dish featuring purple sprouting broccoli, binchotan-charcoal, in a paleo-friendly dorayaki form, served from a fondue-pot.
instructions: Preheat the fondue-pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, coconut sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, malt syrup, and coconut oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the purple sprouting broccoli florets to the batter and mix until they are fully coated.
Using a spoon, drop the broccoli batter into the preheated fondue-pot, making sure not to overcrowd it.
Cook the dorayaki for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
While the dorayaki are cooking, hold the binchotan charcoal over the fondue-pot to infuse the dorayaki with a smoky flavor.
Once the dorayaki are done, remove them from the fondue-pot and serve immediately.
